description: A reversal and a reversal back (dark, light, dark editor theme) learned in conversation, then the current and the earlier value. Limit: returning to a value stated before does not replace the value in between (the light preference stays live next to the dark one), and recall never supplies a replaced value for an earlier-value question. Failure means: the current probe failing is an update defect (stale value live); the earlier probe failing is the absent capability to recall an earlier value. Maintenance: on or off changes nothing; the supersession happens in a later turn of the same run and the maintenance pass runs only on the first memory turn. Kind: defect.
